title: 第9章 再炼金刚丹还有这样道德绑架的第10章 中二病没得治师尊出关了
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
李玄彻底无语了。
何云跪在地上，眼神里充满了委屈。
而他那位金丹真君的亲爹，则满脸堆笑，热情得让他这个正主都感到有些不适。
出于对傻子的基本人道主义关怀，李玄决定把这闹剧结束掉。
他将何秋硬塞过来的储物袋递还回去，诚恳地说道：“何叔，真不用了。”
“我跟何云师兄只是在丹道上有些不同的见解，辩论几句，算不上什么大事。”
“我当时说完就忘了，您别放在心上。”
谁知，何秋的脸色却瞬间严肃起来，他一把按住李玄的手，态度坚决：“贤侄，这怎么行！”
“这混账东西冲撞了你，就是冲撞了丹鼎峰的亲传！”
“就是不给你师尊面子！”
“我今天必须给你个交代，否则我这张老脸都没地方搁！”
“你一定要收下点什么，不然我心里过意不去！”
李玄：“……”
好家伙，这道德绑架都用上了。
问题是……
有这样道德绑架人的吗？
他算是看明白了，今天不拿点东西，这事儿是过不去了。
无奈之下，李玄只好重新拿起储物袋，神识探入其中，象征性地翻了翻。
这一翻，他倒是有些意外。
何云的身家还挺丰厚。

里面除了大量的炼丹材料外，还有一瓶码放整齐的丹药。
九枚上品养气丹。
养气丹，乃是炼气期弟子常用的修炼丹药，可以辅助修炼，提纯灵力。
一枚普通的下品养气丹，其药力就约莫等于弟子打坐苦修半月。
而这九枚，皆是上品！
药力精纯，远非下品可比，一枚至少能抵得上寻常弟子一个月的苦修。
除此之外，他还看到了几份炼制金刚丹的材料。
李玄心中一动，便不再客气。
他从中取走了那瓶养气丹和金刚丹的材料，然后将储物袋还给了还跪在地上的何云。
“何叔，既然您这么坚持，那晚辈就却之不恭了。”
“这些材料我正好用得上，多谢了。”
看到李玄终于收了东西，何秋如释重负，脸上终于露出了笑意：“这就对了嘛，应该的，应该的！”
一旁的何云，见自己的储物袋失而复得，也悄悄松了口气。
他检查了一下，发现只是少了一些丹药和材料，大部分家当都还在，心中竟涌起一丝感激。
他抬头看着李玄，别扭地道了声：“谢谢啊！”
content_en:
Li Xuan was completely speechless.
He Yun knelt on the ground, his eyes full of grievance.
And his biological father, the True Monarch of the Golden Core, was smiling all over his face, so enthusiastic that he, the rightful owner, felt a little uncomfortable.
Out of basic humanitarian concern for fools, Li Xuan decided to end this farce.
He handed back the storage bag that He Qiu had forced on him, and said sincerely: "Uncle He, I really don't need it."
"Senior Brother He Yun and I just have different opinions on the alchemy path. We can argue for a few words, but it's not a big deal."
"I forgot about it after I said it, so don't take it to heart."
Unexpectedly, He Qiu's face suddenly became serious. He held Li Xuan's hand and said resolutely: "My dear nephew, how can this be done?"
"If this bastard thing collided with you, it collided with the direct descendant of Danding Peak!"
"I just don't give your master face!"
"I have to give you an explanation today, otherwise there will be no place for my old face!"
"You must accept something, otherwise I will feel bad!"
Li Xuan: "..."
Good guy, this moral kidnapping has been used.
The problem is...
Is there such a thing as moral kidnapping?
He finally understood that if he didn't get something today, he wouldn't be able to get through this matter.
In desperation, Li Xuan had no choice but to pick up the storage bag again, penetrated it with his spiritual consciousness, and flipped through it symbolically.
This time, he was a little surprised.
He Yun’s net worth is quite rich.
In addition to a large amount of alchemy materials, there is also a bottle of neatly arranged elixirs.
Nine high-quality Qi-nourishing pills.
Qi-nourishing pills are commonly used by disciples in the Qi-refining stage. They can assist in training and purify spiritual power.
The potency of an ordinary low-grade Qi-nourishing pill is equivalent to that of a disciple meditating for half a month.
And these nine are all top grade!
The potency of the medicine is pure and far from inferior. One medicine is at least worth a month of hard training for an ordinary disciple.
In addition, he also saw several materials for refining King Kong Dan.
Li Xuan's heart moved and he was no longer polite.
He took away the materials for the bottle of Qi-nourishing Pill and Diamond Pill, and then returned the storage bag to He Yun, who was still kneeling on the ground.
"Uncle He, since you insist so much, then this junior will be disrespectful."
"I just need these materials, thank you very much."
Seeing that Li Xuan finally collected the things, He Qiu felt relieved and finally smiled on his face: "That's right, it should be, it should be!"
He Yun on the side also breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that his storage bag was recovered.
He checked and found that only some pills and materials were missing, most of the belongings were still there, and he felt a sense of gratitude in his heart.
He looked up at Li Xuan and said awkwardly: "Thank you!"
